name: revolved side angle pose parivrtta parsvakonasana
description: A deep lunge with a twist and hands pressed together. It strengthens the legs and wrings out the spine.
instructions: Step into a long lunge with the back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist your torso and hook the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together and look up or ahead.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
